audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer chart reads Galio L1-2 then Skill x5; content and packet both read Skill L1-2 then Galio x5. The layers disagree on all seven rows.
audit.why: Content whys are matchup-grounded (W magic damage reduction, Q outrange, global R) while the full whys are the generic Malzahar macro template; packet levelChart matches content.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content/packet: Skill early, Galio from level 3 through 2+ items. Lane is playable (51.55% Malz WR) but stage-by-stage Galio holds the trades.

audit.why: Spikes are grounded: Galio takes over at 3 with W, 6 adds the global R (180s), MR first item blunts the suppress; Malz counter-spikes are Lost Chapter shove and using R as peel/lock, which the text states.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention anywhere that Shield of Durand's taunt and Hero's Entrance's knockup break Nether Grasp mid-channel; no Colossal Smash auto-reset tell; tradeGood is the shield-poke template not grounded in Galio; cooldowns field has no digit; packet flags zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Missing-interactions file lists all three; Malz R is flagged channel-interruptible in his own kit.
audit.corrected: Suppress only after W taunt (18s) and R are spent; E (Justice Punch) 11s rank 1 is his only engage; P auto-reset wind-up is the step-back cue.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: He builds tanky and ults cross-map: use R to peel him off your backline or lock him for your team, never to kill.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: E-tick when he steps up to CS, back off before he can answer — never full-combo into Shield of Durand; your rotation only counts when his W is down.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Trading inside Justice Punch range with YOUR shield down — his E-taunt into Colossal Smash deletes the squishiest mage in the pool.

edits.before: Set the metronome: E the wave, shield-manage the poke, and silence only what matters. You are not dueling anyone — you are billing them for tempo.
edits.after: Set the metronome: E the wave and watch his hands — his combo opens with a Colossal Smash auto-reset wind-up; that glow, not the cast, is your step-back cue.

edits.before: Post-6 every lane state includes the Grasp threat: shove, ward, and punish anyone who walks into point-and-click range. With a jungler nearby, your R is a written guarantee.
edits.after: Post-6 every lane state includes the Grasp threat — but his W taunt and R landing both break your channel, so suppress only after they are spent. With a jungler, R is a guarantee.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your spell shield (Iron Boundary) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, 7 at max — his dash knockup; no engage while it is down, and it can cut your retreat, so hold Flash for the wall. - Shield of Durand runs 18s — trade into its downtime. - Nether Grasp (140/110/80s) goes to kill windows only.
